name: Ting Shang Manyue Ying Xizhi ~ The Forever Moon
original_name: 亭上满月映西枝~The Forever Moon
source:
《The Forever Moon》is a puzzle adventure and visual novel doujin game of Touhou Project. It is a love story about Kaguya Houraisan and Fujiwara no Mokou, and a story of Eientei, Bamboo forest of lost and Hakurei Shrine.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1327020/The_Forever_Moon/]Steam[/url]]
